item.title: Radial Harmonic Fourier Moments for CT-based Quantitative Radiomics
item.description: Radiomics is an emerging field of CT image processing, that offers noninvasive quantification of tumour phenotypes using quantitative image features. Radiomics analysis has promising applications in cancer treatment and personalized medicine, like treatment planning and the prediction of clinical factors. item.title: Selecting Execution Path for Replaying Errors
item.description: The identification of the sources of a runtime error is a common task for Erlang developers. Dynamic and static tools can assist in this task. Our work aims to help Erlang developers in debugging processes to reproduce a runtime error. We would like to use and extend the static analyser framework of RefactorErl with new algorithms to support this fault localisation process. item.title: Multithreading Atomicity: Static Analysis Checkers
item.description: Ensuring thread safety in applications is crucial for preventing subtle and challenging bugs in concurrent programming. This paper presents two algorithmic approaches to improve thread safety through static analysis and to demonstrate their benefits in real life, the authors also implemented them as two detectors in SpotBugs static analyzer. item.title: Multi Model Recursion for Hungarian Electricity Load Forecasting
item.description: Time series analysis and prediction is a difficult and complex problem. Many machine- and deep-learning methods exist with better and better results. This paper proposes a strategy called Multi Model Recursion. It uses separate deep-learning models per feature that needs predicting. item.title: Smart Contract in the Loop: Fault Impact Assessment for Distributed Ledger Technologies
item.description: Due to their decentralized and trustless nature, blockchain and distributed ledger technologies are increasingly used in several domains, including critical applications. item.title: Towards Correct Dependency Orders in Erlang Upgrades
item.description: Erlang tooling offers rich options to control the exact tasks to perform during an upgrade. This control aims to allow for zero-downtime upgrades.
